title: Historical Event 1: Zomato Acquires Grofers / Rebrands to Blinkit (2022-2023)
context: Zomato acquired distressed 10-minute grocery pioneer Grofers for ₹4,447 Cr ($570M). Critics predicted massive cash drain. Zomato slashed overhead, integrated tech, and expanded dark stores from 400 to 600+.
modelInputShocks: Funding integration with deep-pocketed public parent
Network economies of scale in rider fleet utilization
Supplier cross-bargaining leverage across dining + grocery

predictedDirection.bcgShift: Question Mark transitions to dominant Star
predictedDirection.industryAttractiveness: Rivalry intensifies, but leader captures scale economies and nears contribution break-even

actualOutcome.marketShare: Blinkit reached ~40-45% market share in metro clusters by mid-2024
actualOutcome.financials: Blinkit GOV grew 137% YoY in FY24; achieved positive adjusted EBITDA in Q4 FY24 (before corporate overhead)
actualOutcome.varianceAnalysis: The model accurately forecasted that scale economies in dark store density create a flywheel: order density reduces per-order rider transit distance, driving delivery cost below ₹50.

source: Zomato Ltd Official Shareholder Letters (Q1 FY23 - Q4 FY24) [PLACEHOLDER for full annual reconciliation]

title: Historical Event 2: Zepto's $665M Funding Surge at $3.6B Valuation (June 2024)
context: Zepto raised $665M from Avenir, Lightspeed, Avra, and step-up domestic HNIs, tripling its valuation in 9 months to fund a doubling of dark stores from 350 to 700.
modelInputShocks: Dark store land-grab war against Blinkit

predictedDirection.marketShare: Protect and expand market share towards 30-32%
predictedDirection.bcgShift: High growth, high investment capital burn Star
predictedDirection.industryAttractiveness: Threat of Entrants drops for outside players; Rivalry reaches peak level (9+ out of 10)

actualOutcome.marketShare: Zepto market share stabilized at ~29-31%, expanding aggressively into Delhi-NCR to challenge Blinkit's home turf
actualOutcome.financials: Burn rate rose temporarily to $15-20M/month during dark-store fitout phase, followed by rapid store-level maturation
actualOutcome.varianceAnalysis: Matches model predictions of oligopolistic pre-emption: capital raised was utilized to lock in high-density urban catchments before competitors could lease them.

source: TechCrunch, Economic Times, Entrackr venture funding reports 2024 [PLACEHOLDER for verified cap table]

title: Historical Event 3: Industry-Wide Platform Fee & Handling Fee Hikes (2023-2024)
context: All major platforms simultaneously introduced and incrementally increased mandatory 'Platform / Handling Fees' from ₹2 to ₹4, ₹6, and up to ₹10 during peak hours.
modelInputShocks: Coordinated pricing discipline (Tacit Collusion / Price leadership)
Direct margin improvement per order without changing SKU listed prices

predictedDirection.marketShare: Relatively stable shares across oligopolists as all matched price increases within weeks
predictedDirection.bcgShift: Improves cash generation across all quadrants, nudging stars closer to cash cow viability
predictedDirection.industryAttractiveness: Buyer power tested; slight increase in substitute friction, but consumer churn remained low

actualOutcome.marketShare: Volumes dipped for 7-10 days upon introduction but fully recovered; orders proved relatively price-inelastic below ₹10 threshold
actualOutcome.financials: Generated estimated ₹300-450 Cr in high-margin pure contribution across platforms, materially accelerating EBITDA roadmaps
actualOutcome.varianceAnalysis: Confirms model's kinked-demand curve and oligopolistic price leadership: when the dominant player tests a price hike, competitors follow rather than start a price war.

source: Zomato & Swiggy earnings calls & consumer order invoice comparisons [PLACEHOLDER]
